title: Push
goal: Top of the rep range. Last working sets can be RPE 8. Wrist block unchanged.

wrist.notes: Keep the rehab easy even if the main lifts feel hard.

sessions.title: Upper A
sessions.notes: Best week of the block. Last sets can be hard. Wrist block stays easy.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip DB bench press
exercises.load: Top of the range. Last set can be RPE 8.
exercises.notes: Palms face each other. No barbell bench. Set the DBs on your thighs to get into position.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.notes: Chest on the pad. Neutral handles. Use straps if the grip or wrist complains.

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.load: Push the last set. Stop before a grind.
exercises.notes: One end in a landmine or corner. Neutral-ish path, no heavy barbell overhead.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.notes: Low back stays on the floor. Opposite arm and leg, slow.

sessions.title: Lower A
sessions.notes: Strong but pretty. No missed reps, no ugly last squat.

exercises.name: Back squat or goblet squat
exercises.load: Best controlled sixes of the block. Not a max.
exercises.notes: High-bar or goblet if the bar bothers the wrist. Cup a DB or use a kettlebell so the wrist stays stacked.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.load: Straps on. Strong but not ugly.
exercises.notes: Straps on. Soft knees, long hamstrings, bar close. Neutral grip under the straps.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.load: Working DBs. Same depth both legs.
exercises.notes: DBs at your sides, wrists straight. Short the stance if the front knee is noisy.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.notes: Elbow under shoulder. Hips high. Drop to a knee if the wrist would take the load on a straight-arm plank.

sessions.title: Upper B
sessions.notes: Push the incline and row. Stop a rep before form breaks.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip DB incline press
exercises.load: Top of the range. Last set can be RPE 8.
exercises.notes: Low incline. Palms in. Same wrist-friendly press as Upper A, different angle.

exercises.name: One-arm DB row
exercises.notes: Strap on the working hand. Other hand on a bench. Neutral wrist, pull to the hip.

exercises.name: Seated neutral-grip DB press
exercises.load: Push the last set. Stop before a grind.
exercises.notes: Palms face each other. No barbell push press. Stop at eye level if the wrist nags.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.notes: Opposite arm and leg. Square hips. Pause a beat at the long position.

sessions.title: Lower B
sessions.notes: Best controlled single-leg week. Then treat the wrist like glass.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.load: Best controlled sixes of the block. Not a max.
exercises.notes: Cup the top of the DB or use a kettlebell. Wrist stacked, elbows down. No front-rack barbell.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.notes: Straps on. Free hand for a light balance touch. Soft knee, hips square.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.load: Working DBs. Same depth both legs.
exercises.notes: DBs at your sides. Step back, front shin vertical. Neutral wrists.

exercises.name: Suitcase hold
exercises.load: Stay tall. Put it down if the side folds.
exercises.notes: DB in one hand, stand tall. Do not lean away. Switch sides every set.
